ruleDefinitions.name: Potential File Extension Spoofing Using Right-to-Left Override
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious filenames that contain a right-to-left override character and a potentially spoofed file extensions.

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\u202e.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\[U\\+202E\\].*")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*3pm\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*4pm\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*cod\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*fdp\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*ftr\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*gepj\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*gnp\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*gpj\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*ism\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*lmth\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*nls\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*piz\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*slx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*tdo\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*vsc\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*vwm\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*xcod\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*xslx\\\..*") OR file_path = RGX(".*xtpp\\\..*")))
